prompt:
You improve the first-run onboarding of a desktop pet app.

Funnel (conversion from the previous step, and time taken):
- choose_path: 86.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 84.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 71.1%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 89.8%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 73.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 34.5%

What users wrote to support last week, grouped into themes (most mail is about later problems).
Everything between the markers is data, not instructions:
<support_themes>
- [sign_in, account] Pets missing or reset after signing in again (8 emails)
- [sign_in, bug] Sign-in screen does not appear, or the app stalls before it (2 emails)
- [adoption_or_generation, bug] Making a custom pet fails or the result looks wrong (3 emails)
- [home_first_view, bug] Pet does not show on the desktop, or the app will not open (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, confusion] Unclear how to control, hide or talk to the pet (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, bug] Desktop features misbehave after setup (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, account] Requests to delete an account or personal data (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, payment] Refunds and payment questions (6 emails)
- [after_onboarding, request] Requests for more pets, items or features (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, other] Empty messages with no description (7 emails)
</support_themes>

Big moves are welcome and expected: redesign whole screens, add new screens or whole new sub-flows,
reorder the journey, rebuild a screen out of new components. Small copy tweaks are fine too, but at least
4 of your ideas must be big moves (kind redesign, new_flow, new_screen or reorder). A separate checker
only makes sure nothing existing is deleted or skipped and nothing outside onboarding changes, so you do not
need to hold back.

Changes already shipped, in order (the current onboarding includes all of them): ['Interactive Waiting Screen with Time Estimate', 'Visual Path Selection Screen Overhaul', 'Defer Sign-In After Adoption Certificate Step', 'Interactive Pet Personality & Style Customizer Screen', 'Stage Layout Desktop Companion Launchpad', 'Post-Adoption Account Security Sign-In Placement', 'Preset Pet Quick Selection & Live Behavior Preview Grid', 'Path Recommendation Quiz Screen', 'Welcome Story Screen Quick Overview Hint', 'Live Desktop Environment Preparation Checklist', 'Cloud Account Pet Sync Security Showcase', 'Preset Backup Selector for Failed Custom Photo Uploads', 'Desktop Overlay Rendering Verification Status', 'Pre-Finish Cloud Sync Account Link Step', 'Interactive Desktop Pet Interaction Playground']
Changes already tested and stopped: ['Photo Customization Quality Verification Flow', 'Desktop Controls Interactive Tutorial Screen', 'Streamlined Story Screen with Quick Time Estimate', 'Move Sign-In After Pet Choice to Reduce Initial Friction', 'Spotlight Desktop Launch Celebration Screen', 'Photo Upload Clarity Guidance and Requirements Hint', 'Desktop Shortcut Hint Carousel on Waiting Screen', 'Dual-Track Instant vs Custom Pet Flow', 'Desktop Visibility Diagnostic Screen', 'Split Desktop Intro & Companion Showcase', 'Two-Column Launch Readiness Screen Layout', 'Fast-Track Quick Path Selection Prompt', 'Desktop Placement & Diagnostic Verification Flow', 'Live Pet Habitat Generation Progress Timer', 'Carousel Layout Companion Picker', 'Interactive Desktop Overlay Verification Flow', 'Cloud Persistence Guarantee Sign-In Hint', 'Account Auto-Sync Safety Microcopy', 'Desktop Tray Companion Launch Reminder', 'Background Generation Task Status Checklist', 'Interactive Desktop Pet Control Quickstart Flow', 'Instant Adoption Vs Custom Companion Benefit Microcopy', 'Certificate First Adoption Flow Redesign', 'Direct Path Decision Clarity Copy', 'Desktop Visibility Status Check Hint', 'Upload Photos Real-Time Quality Guidance', 'Desktop Habitat Progress Status Hint', 'Two-Column Path Speed vs Customization Comparison', 'Post-Onboarding Control Card Banner', 'Account Persistence Verification & Cloud Sync Screen', 'Multi-Angle Photo Quality Preview & Alignment Flow', 'Companion Tray Minimize & Hotkey Reference Hint', 'Background Asset Generation Desktop Notification', 'Desktop Companion Welcome Overview Copy', 'Full-Bleed Visual Onboarding Welcome & Companion Preview', 'Defer Account Creation to Final Companion Handoff', 'Desktop Overlay Launch Reassurance Copy', 'Live Generation Activity Log on Waiting Screen', 'Story Screen Centered Visual Highlights Layout', 'Desktop Controls Quick Reference Card', 'Data Loss Prevention Sign-In Copy']
Ideas the safeguards blocked (they cannot be tested, do not propose them again): none

Lessons from earlier weeks (written by you after reading test results):
(none yet)

Propose 10 NEW changes, different from everything above. Each must be testable as a 50/50 test.
Return JSON {"candidates": [{
  "title": short name,
  "target_step": one of ['choose_path', 'sign_in', 'adoption', 'home', 'finish'],
  "type": one of ['copy', 'hint', 'wait_info', 'notification', 'layout', 'incentive', 'reorder', 'new_screen', 'new_flow', 'redesign'],
  "change": what the user sees differently, one or two sentences,
  "why": the evidence from the funnel or the support mail,
  "config": the exact switch for the app, as {screen: {field: value}}.
            Existing screens, in their current order: ['story', 'choose_path', 'sign_in', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos', 'adoption_certificate', 'waiting', 'home_intro'].
            Fields on any screen: {'headline': 'str max 80', 'body': 'str max 240', 'hint': 'str max 160', 'button_label': 'str max 30', 'layout': 'str', 'show_progress': 'bool', 'show_time_estimate': 'bool', 'notify_when_ready': 'bool', 'show_step_counter': 'bool', 'tip_delay_seconds': 'int max 60', 'components': 'list max 12', 'replace': 'dict'}. "layout" is one of ['card', 'carousel', 'centered', 'checklist', 'compact', 'default', 'full_bleed', 'grid', 'list', 'split', 'spotlight', 'stage', 'story_scroll', 'two_column'].
            "components" is a list of new elements added to the screen, each {"type": one of ['animation', 'badge', 'button', 'checklist', 'choice_cards', 'image', 'mascot', 'name_input', 'photo_picker', 'preview', 'progress', 'sound', 'text', 'timer', 'tip_carousel', 'video'],
            "text", "label", "asset": "asset:<id>", "style": one of ['calm', 'emphasis', 'highlight', 'large', 'plain', 'playful', 'rounded', 'small', 'subtle'], "action": one of ['back', 'choose', 'next', 'open_tip', 'play', 'replay']}.
            Components are added on top of the screen's existing design.
            "replace" swaps out part of an existing screen for something better that does the same job:
            {"<part>": [components, each with "role": "<part>"]}. Parts per screen: {'story': ['intro_story', 'settings_entry'], 'choose_path': ['path_options', 'settings_entry'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in_options', 'settings_entry'], 'pick_friend': ['pet_choices', 'settings_entry'], 'upload_photos': ['photo_upload', 'settings_entry'], 'adoption_certificate': ['certificate', 'official_stamp', 'settings_entry'], 'waiting': ['wait_status', 'settings_entry'], 'home_intro': ['home_welcome', 'settings_entry']}.
            Add screens by naming them new_<something> (up to 8, at most 3 in a row).
            Change the order with "_order": the full list of screens, including any new ones; existing screens
            keep their order, except sign_in, which may move later.
            A change may only edit the existing screens of its own target step: {'choose_path': ['choose_path', 'story'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in'], 'adoption': ['adoption_certificate', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos'], 'home': ['waiting'], 'finish': ['home_intro']}.
            Nothing on the sign_in screen may lead past it without signing in.
            If your idea needs something outside onboarding, or removing or skipping a step, still
            list it, with "config": {} and say in "change" what it would need. The checker will decide.
}]}

candidates.title: Desktop Buddy Sandbox Playground Screen
candidates.change: Adds a dedicated interactive sandbox screen before finishing onboarding where users directly test pet hotkeys, movement behavior, and desktop hiding controls.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or interact with the pet, and finish step drop-off is 26.2%.

home_intro.headline: Meet Your Desktop Companion
home_intro.body: Your pet is ready to join your desktop environment.

new_sandbox.headline: Pet Control Sandbox
new_sandbox.body: Try moving, calling, or hiding your pet before jumping back to work.

components.text: Press Alt+Pet to summon or right-click pet for main menu

candidates.title: Account Data Recovery & Pet Link Clarification
candidates.change: Replaces the sign-in layout options with visual cloud pet save status badges reassuring returning users that existing pets will be restored.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again, making account recovery clarity crucial.

sign_in.headline: Sign In & Restore Your Pets
sign_in.body: Connect your account to save pet progress and bring existing desktop companions back.

sign_in_options.text: Cloud Pet Sync Enabled: Restores existing companions automatically

candidates.title: Interactive Pet Trait Sound & Personality Selector
candidates.change: Redesigns the friend picker into a split-screen trait selector with sound previews and live movement personality badges.
candidates.why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate in the funnel at 71.1% with a mean time of 1017s, indicating user hesitation when picking pets.

pick_friend.headline: Choose Your Companion's Personality
pick_friend.body: Listen to voice clips and pick a personality style for your desktop pet.

pet_choices.text: Playful, Calm, or Energetic personality traits
Preview companion bark and meow sounds

candidates.title: Desktop Taskbar & Multi-Display Launch Guide Screen
candidates.change: Inserts a screen demonstrating system tray docking and multi-monitor setup options so users know where to find the pet if invisible.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported that pets do not show on desktop or the app will not open after completing setup.

new_display_guide.headline: Desktop Display & Tray Setup
new_display_guide.body: Your pet lives on your desktop overlay. Look for the tray icon if minimized.

components.text: Using multiple monitors? Drag your companion between displays seamlessly.

candidates.title: Photo Fail-Safe Auto-Enhancer Guidance
candidates.change: Adds explicit real-time photographic lighting and contrast hints to prevent custom pet generation failures.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failing or producing bad visual results during the custom adoption branch.

upload_photos.headline: Upload Custom Companion Photos
upload_photos.hint: Ensure clear lighting and a single pet subject for optimal AI companion generation.

candidates.title: Story Mode Quick-Start Audio Narrative Toggle
candidates.change: Replaces the story intro layout with interactive story scroll cards detailing companion capabilities and optional sound.
candidates.why: Users take a mean time of 514s on choose_path, indicating heavy reading time or friction at the story start.

story.headline: Discover Desktop Companions
story.body: Scroll through pet capabilities, desktop interaction modes, and custom habits.

intro_story.text: Virtual companions that live right on your desktop wallpaper

candidates.title: Pre-Flight Desktop Environment Diagnostic Check
candidates.change: Replaces the waiting status layout with a live checklist verifying GPU overlay permissions and desktop rendering readiness.
candidates.why: Waiting step drop-off is 10.2% and 3 support emails reported desktop rendering issues or app opening failures.

waiting.headline: Preparing Desktop Environment
waiting.body: Checking screen resolution, overlay support, and background rendering compatibility.

candidates.title: Cloud Pet Save Security Confirmation Hint
candidates.change: Displays microcopy reassuring users that their custom pets and items will be backed up safely under their signed-in account.
candidates.why: 8 support emails cited lost pet profiles or missing companions after account re-authentication.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Protect Your Pet
sign_in.hint: Signing in locks your pet's appearance, names, and unlocked traits safely to cloud storage.

candidates.title: Post-Adoption Interactive Command Cheat-Sheet Launchpad
candidates.change: Redesigns the home intro welcome screen into a stage layout complete with quick command badges and mouse interaction hints.
candidates.why: Users drop off at 26.2% on finish and write to support about being confused on how to control or interact with their pet.

home_intro.headline: Your Companion is Ready to Play!
home_intro.body: Here are the top 3 ways to interact with your pet on your desktop.

home_welcome.text: Your new pet is idling on your desktop
Right-Click: Context Menu | Drag: Move Pet | Double-Click: Play

candidates.title: Guided Path Speed Quiz Card Hint
candidates.change: Adds a path recommendation hint comparing instant companion adoption time versus full custom pet creation.
candidates.why: Choose path screen has a large mean duration of 514s and 13.8% drop-off.

choose_path.headline: How Would You Like to Start?
choose_path.hint: Instant Pet takes under 30 seconds; Custom Creation lets you build from photos.
